name: dsh-work-memory
description: 对话级工作记忆索引：记住用户提过的需求与产物路径，命中后按 session/seq 回放被上下文压缩的原文。

summary.zh: 对话级工作记忆索引：把用户提过的需求、产物路径与 session/seq 指针存成钩子；命中后按 seq 回放当时被压缩的原文。不总结对话、不调模型、纯本地。
summary.en: Conversation-level work memory: index each user request with its artifact paths and a session/seq pointer, then replay the compacted original span on demand. No summarisation, no model calls, local only.
